cases.description: Northbridge (synthetic) band A: the published yearly amount and its exact monthly amount.

rule.source: Council tax band amounts are published yearly (inputs); monthly = yearly / 12 rounded once to the nearest penny, halves away from zero (decision 0021)

steps.description: Published yearly amount for band A is 144000 pence (a recorded input, £1,440).
144000 / 12 = 12000 exactly, nothing to round.

cases.description: 6 pence a year: 6 / 12 = 0.5 exactly, so it rounds away from zero.

rule.source: Council tax band amounts are published yearly (inputs); monthly = yearly / 12 rounded once to the nearest penny, halves away from zero (decision 0021)

steps.description: 12 x 0 = 0; 6 - 0 = 6 left over, which is exactly half of 12, so 6 / 12 = 0.5
Exactly half rounds away from zero, up to 1.

cases.description: Westmere (synthetic) has no council tax record in its source: no yearly amount and no monthly figure, never £0.

rule.source: Council tax band amounts are published yearly (inputs); monthly = yearly / 12 rounded once to the nearest penny, halves away from zero (decision 0021)

steps.description: The bands fact has status no-record-in-source and carries no value.
With no yearly amount there is nothing to divide, so there is no monthly figure either (rule 7: a gap is not zero).
